newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Colonial offers franchise banking.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Colonial offers franchise banking.

text.p: Colonial State Bank said on Monday it would introduce franchise banking around Australia.
Managing director Stuart James said the progressive franchising of the bank's branch network was the next stage in the Colonial group's innovative distribution strategy.
About 60 "trade areas" around Australia had been identified as having potential for individual franchises, the bank, which is owned by insurance group Colonial Ltd, said in a statement.
"The objective of franchising is to move customer service to a new plateau, by combining the strength of a major corporatiion with the commitment of the individual owner," James said.

"Of course customer security, confidentiality and privacy will be assured by maintaining current systems and controls," he said. "Franchisees will not have loan delegation authority and the management of credit will be maintained by the bank."
The franchising move would speed up the roll-out of the bank's national network and lower distribution costs, he said.

"It is anticipated that Colonial State Bank franchise owners will be drawn from existing senior staff, from highly successful external executives and from the Colonial insurance franchises," James said.
He described the initiative as the world's first true banking franchise system.
He gave no details about how the franchisee would profit.
However, a spokesman said franchisees would have an individual stake in the business.
The Reserve Bank of Australia, the New South Wales state government and labour unions had been fully advised of Colonial's plan, the bank said.
Franchises would be configured on a "hub and spoke" basis, the hub being the primary location offering all group services, and the spokes being mainly sales and service locations.
Colonial State Bank was formerly the State Bank of New South Wales before the state government sold it to the Colonial group in 1994.
Colonial Ltd is expected to list on the Australian and New Zealand stock exchanges around mid-year.
